answer:
The most important thing: your stool test (FIT) on 2025-11-04 was positive, and I can't find any follow-up in your records, such as a colonoscopy or a referral. A positive FIT needs a colonoscopy, usually within a few months, so please raise this first.

Other things to bring up:
- Cholesterol: in February 2025 your LDL was 131 (above target for someone with diabetes) and you were started on atorvastatin. I see no cholesterol recheck since, so it's unknown whether the statin is working.
- Diabetes: your A1c rose from 6.5 (2023) to 8.3 (Jan 2025), then came down to 6.9 (Feb 2026). Metformin was stopped in April 2024 with no reason recorded, and Jardiance is now listed. Ask whether stopping metformin was intended. Your kidney numbers are normal (eGFR 69, a small drift down from 73). Your last A1c was in February 2026, so one is due.
- Diabetes checks I can't find: urine albumin test, eye exam, foot exam. They may have been done elsewhere.
- No vaccines are recorded (flu, COVID, pneumonia, shingles, etc.), and no breast cancer screening or bone density test. These may simply be held elsewhere; at 69 they are worth checking.
- The July 2025 chest pain visit: CT showed no pulmonary embolism and the chest wall pain resolved. Nothing further needed, but the CT noted mild spine degeneration, which is common.

The records can't tell me whether tests were done at other places, so ask your doctor to confirm.
